children: TDG agreed to sell Freeport a 51% interest in Aurora West for C$110M cash at closing, retaining 49%. Freeport may earn additional interests by funding C$80M of expenditures and paying TDG C$40M; closing is subject to customary conditions, including TSXV approval.
Freeport to pay C$110M for an initial 51%
The cash proceeds are payable at closing; no prior-period comparison applies to this transaction.
TDG retains 49% after the initial sale
TDG retains exposure to Aurora West, but its future ownership depends on Freeport's earn-in option.
Freeport may fund C$80M and pay TDG C$40M
If the option is exercised, Freeport can raise its Aurora West JVCo stake to 75% and acquire all of ClaimsCo.
At least C$15M is due within 2 years; funding supports the earn-in but does not guarantee its exercise.
Closing subject to conditions, including TSXV approval
The C$110M proceeds are contingent on closing; the release expects closing after conditions are met.

This is a strategic asset-sale and joint-venture transaction, not a reported operating trend. Closing and Freeport's subsequent expenditure funding and option decisions will determine the realized proceeds and TDG's remaining exposure.
from TDG Gold Corp. distributed by GlobeNewswire.
